I spent an hour last night with Jerry and Allison 

Key insights 

- it is a very healthy sign that the value aligned partners upon hearing the message immediately extends offer to support the cause. This means our brand story is on point 

- ours is a value/identity based marketing 

- as such video/visual content on our site should be centric around the people as opposed to the product 

- the CTA to action to be tested should be Join the Movement 

- some references of companies that have implemented good content based conversion are as attached 

- 501c registration was surfaced again a second time. This time by Allison who has experience registering non-profits in the USA as an activist. The church should be registered as an LLC and then using the details of the LLC registration with IRS as a later step to acquire 501c status 

- Jerry has expressed intention to support our efforts by joining and offer cacao in Davos next season.

Me and Jerry spent 30 minutes studying the supply chain out of Peru

https://selenohealth.com/products/ceremonial-cacao-paste-peru-1kg?variant=41260908544180

After factoring in the shipping cost our pricing for $50 per kg is competitive

- ADHD usage - dopamine boost
- Fat loss
- Caffeine replacement 
- need to make it taste good without sugar like Celsius 
- distribution is still key 
- make sure brand gets index by ChatGpt for the keywords
